jobs.title: HR Business Partner
jobs.description:
Connecteam is the leading platform for managing deskless teams, trusted by over 80,000 businesses worldwide.

We built Connecteam for real operators - the people running shifts, jobs, and teams across stores and sites. The kind of work that doesn’t happen behind a desk, and doesn’t have time for messy spreadsheets, scattered group chats, or tools that don’t talk to each other.

Connecteam brings daily operations and team communication into one intuitive app - from hiring and scheduling to training, tasks, and day-to-day coordination. It gives teams the clarity and control to run the day, shift after shift, job after job.

Backed by $220M+ from Insight Partners, Stripes, and Tiger Global, Connecteam is rapidly expanding worldwide - empowering frontline teams to work smarter, stay connected, and operate with greater efficiency.

We are looking for a HR Business Partner (HRBP) that will play a crucial role in collaborating with the management team and employees within the department.

About this role:

As an HR Business Partner at Connecteam, you will be a strategic partner to leaders across the organization, helping shape high-performing teams, support organizational growth, and create an exceptional employee experience. You'll combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution, partnering closely with managers to solve complex people challenges and drive business success in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

Key Responsibilities

- Partner closely with business leaders to understand organizational priorities and translate business needs into effective people strategies.

- Serve as a trusted advisor to managers and employees on all people-related topics, including performance management, employee relations, career development, organizational design, and change management.

- Coach and support managers in developing high-performing teams and fostering a strong leadership culture.

- Drive employee engagement, retention, and organizational health initiatives that strengthen the employee experience.

- Own the end-to-end employee lifecycle, ensuring a seamless experience from onboarding through offboarding.

- Analyze people data and organizational trends to identify opportunities, provide actionable insights, and support data-driven decision making.

- Partner with leaders on workforce planning, talent reviews, succession planning, and organizational effectiveness.

- Facilitate organizational change by supporting leaders through periods of growth, transformation, and team evolution.

- Collaborate closely with the People team to lead and implement cross-functional HR initiatives, programs, and projects.

- Champion Connecteam's culture and values while helping create an inclusive, high-performing workplace.

Experience & Skills

- 5+ years of experience as an HR Business Partner in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

- Strong business acumen with the ability to align people strategies with business objectives.

- Proven experience coaching managers and influencing stakeholders across different levels of the organization.

- Strong knowledge of performance management, employee relations, organizational development, and talent management.

- Excellent analytical skills with the ability to leverage data to drive decisions and measure impact.

- Outstanding interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build trust and strong partnerships.

- Highly proactive, independent, and comfortable navigating ambiguity in a dynamic environment.

- Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field.

- Passion for building exceptional employee experiences and helping organizations scale successfully.

jobs.title: Strategic Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Strategic Customer Success Manager

Who Connecteam is:

Connecteam is the leading platform for managing deskless teams, trusted by over 80,000 businesses worldwide.

We built Connecteam for real operators - the people running shifts, jobs, and teams across stores and sites. The kind of work that doesn’t happen behind a desk, and doesn’t have time for messy spreadsheets, scattered group chats, or tools that don’t talk to each other.

Connecteam brings daily operations and team communication into one intuitive app - from hiring and scheduling to training, tasks, and day-to-day coordination. It gives teams the clarity and control to run the day, shift after shift, job after job.

Backed by $220M+ from Insight Partners, Stripes, and Tiger Global, Connecteam is rapidly expanding worldwide - empowering frontline teams to work smarter, stay connected, and operate with greater efficiency.

About The Role

The Strategic Customer Success Manager is responsible for overseeing Connecteam’s most significant and high-value Enterprise and Strategic customers in the US. This role requires a proactive, consultative, and data-driven approach to Customer Success, ensuring long-term client retention, expansion, and advocacy.

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in enterprise SaaS, a deep understanding of workforce management processes, and the ability to act as a trusted advisor to executive stakeholders. They will leverage their expertise in digital transformation, change management, and adoption strategies to drive value realization across complex organizations.

This is a fully remote position. The ideal candidate must be based in the United States and be comfortable working across multiple time zones.

Key Responsibilities

- Customer Strategy & Value Realization: Develop and execute strategic success plans aligned with customers’ key business objectives to ensure long-term retention and growth.

- Enterprise Stakeholder Engagement: Build and nurture strong relationships with C-level executives, IT teams, and operational leaders to drive adoption and advocacy.

- Consultative Approach: Partner with customers to solve critical business challenges, implement best practices, and maximize the value of Connecteam’s platform.

- Expansion & Growth: Identify expansion opportunities within accounts and collaborate with Sales to drive upsells and cross-sells.

- Data-Driven Decision-Making: Leverage customer usage analytics and feedback to proactively identify risks, opportunities, and areas for improvement.

- Customer Advocacy & Thought Leadership: Partner with Marketing to develop case studies and promote customer success stories.

- Escalation Management: Act as the primary escalation point, working cross-functionally to resolve complex challenges quickly and effectively.

- Industry Expertise & Best Practices: Stay ahead of industry trends, competitors, and workforce management best practices to serve as a subject matter expert.

Experience & Skills

- 3+ years of B2B SaaS experience in a Customer Success, Account Management, or Consulting role – MUST

- Experience managing Enterprise/Strategic accounts (ACV of $100K+) – MUST

- Proven ability to engage with and influence senior executives (VP, C-Level)

- Track record of driving expansion within a customer portfolio

- Expertise in digital transformation, change management, and complex adoption strategies

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including executive presentations

- Analytical mindset with experience leveraging customer data for decision-making

- Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment and drive initiatives independently

- Experience collaborating with global teams across different time zones

- This role is fully remote; however, occasional travel may be required for onsite customer visits, executive business reviews, and industry events.

Advantage:

- Experience working in an international, remote-first SaaS company

- Background in HR Tech, Workforce Management, or related industries

Benefits:

- Medical,dental, vision insurance.

- Paid time off for vacation, sick days, holidays.

- 401(k)

Salary range: $ 100K-$140K

We are accepting applications from employees working in the following states: Texas, New York, New Jersey, South Carolina, North Carolina, Colorado, Florida, Utah, and Georgia.

jobs.title: Strategic Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Strategic Customer Success Manager

Who Connecteam is:

Connecteam is the leading platform for managing deskless teams, trusted by over 80,000 businesses worldwide.

We built Connecteam for real operators - the people running shifts, jobs, and teams across stores and sites. The kind of work that doesn’t happen behind a desk, and doesn’t have time for messy spreadsheets, scattered group chats, or tools that don’t talk to each other.

Connecteam brings daily operations and team communication into one intuitive app - from hiring and scheduling to training, tasks, and day-to-day coordination. It gives teams the clarity and control to run the day, shift after shift, job after job.

Backed by $220M+ from Insight Partners, Stripes, and Tiger Global, Connecteam is rapidly expanding worldwide - empowering frontline teams to work smarter, stay connected, and operate with greater efficiency.

About The Role

The Strategic Customer Success Manager is responsible for overseeing Connecteam’s most significant and high-value Enterprise and Strategic customers in the US. This role requires a proactive, consultative, and data-driven approach to Customer Success, ensuring long-term client retention, expansion, and advocacy.

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in enterprise SaaS, a deep understanding of workforce management processes, and the ability to act as a trusted advisor to executive stakeholders. They will leverage their expertise in digital transformation, change management, and adoption strategies to drive value realization across complex organizations.

This is a fully remote position. The ideal candidate must be based in the United States and be comfortable working across multiple time zones.

Key Responsibilities

- Customer Strategy & Value Realization: Develop and execute strategic success plans aligned with customers’ key business objectives to ensure long-term retention and growth.

- Enterprise Stakeholder Engagement: Build and nurture strong relationships with C-level executives, IT teams, and operational leaders to drive adoption and advocacy.

- Consultative Approach: Partner with customers to solve critical business challenges, implement best practices, and maximize the value of Connecteam’s platform.

- Expansion & Growth: Identify expansion opportunities within accounts and collaborate with Sales to drive upsells and cross-sells.

- Data-Driven Decision-Making: Leverage customer usage analytics and feedback to proactively identify risks, opportunities, and areas for improvement.

- Customer Advocacy & Thought Leadership: Partner with Marketing to develop case studies and promote customer success stories.

- Escalation Management: Act as the primary escalation point, working cross-functionally to resolve complex challenges quickly and effectively.

- Industry Expertise & Best Practices: Stay ahead of industry trends, competitors, and workforce management best practices to serve as a subject matter expert.

Experience & Skills

- 3+ years of B2B SaaS experience in a Customer Success, Account Management, or Consulting role – MUST

- Experience managing Enterprise/Strategic accounts (ACV of $100K+) – MUST

- Proven ability to engage with and influence senior executives (VP, C-Level)

- Track record of driving expansion within a customer portfolio

- Expertise in digital transformation, change management, and complex adoption strategies

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including executive presentations

- Analytical mindset with experience leveraging customer data for decision-making

- Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment and drive initiatives independently

- Experience collaborating with global teams across different time zones

- This role is fully remote; however, occasional travel may be required for onsite customer visits, executive business reviews, and industry events.

Advantage:

- Experience working in an international, remote-first SaaS company

- Background in HR Tech, Workforce Management, or related industries

Benefits:

- Medical,dental, vision insurance.

- Paid time off for vacation, sick days, holidays.

- 401(k)

Salary range: $ 100K-$140K

We are accepting applications from employees working in the following states: Texas, New York, New Jersey, South Carolina, North Carolina, Colorado, Florida, Utah, and Georgia.
